title: S1File Full Questionnaire
author: Chris Englert
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.uj3euqn

steps.title: Initial Participant Screening and Baseline
steps.instruction: Collect participant identification and baseline self-control data.

substeps.instruction: Assign a participant number and assign the participant to either the 'Ego Depletion' or 'No Ego Depletion' condition.
Administer a self-control questionnaire where participants rate 13 statements on a scale from 1 (completely inapplicable) to 5 (exactly applicable).

steps.title: Perform Attention Control Task
steps.instruction: Depending on the assigned condition, have the participant transcribe the provided text about Mannheim onto a sheet of paper as quickly as possible without careless errors.

substeps.instruction: For the 'Ego Depletion' condition: Instruct participants to omit all letters 'e' and 'n' during transcription.
For the 'No Ego Depletion' condition: Instruct participants to transcribe the text normally.

steps.title: Post-Transcription Assessment
steps.instruction: Administer questionnaires to evaluate the mental state and effort following the transcription task.

substeps.instruction: Collect ratings on mental exhaustion, task effort, difficulty following instructions, regulation of writing habits, and perceived performance.
Collect ratings on current emotional states (e.g., interested, annoyed, nervous, active) using a 5-point scale from 'not at all' to 'extremely'.

steps.title: Video Observation Task
steps.instruction: Present a six-minute silent video of a woman being interviewed by an off-camera person while recording eye-tracking data.

substeps.instruction: Instruct participants to focus exclusively on the woman and strictly avoid reading any words that appear on the screen.
Instruct participants that if they accidentally look at a word, they must immediately redirect their attention back to the woman.

steps.title: Post-Video Assessment
steps.instruction: Administer a questionnaire regarding the video experience and the subject of the video.

substeps.instruction: Collect ratings (scale 1-7) on the effort of suppressing the urge to look at words, the effort of watching the video, and perceptions of the woman (sympathy, excitement, attentiveness, introversion, interest, and engagement).

steps.title: Final Data Collection
steps.instruction: Collect qualitative feedback and demographic information.

substeps.instruction: Ask participants to describe the purpose of the study in their own words.
Query if the participant had prior knowledge of the study and what that knowledge was.
Collect demographic data: gender, age, nationality, profession, and German language fluency.
